goal: Support UNIX domain sockets for local HTTP RPC connections and bitcoin-cli
Allows using filesystem permissions for access control and eliminates TCP loopback overhead
reviewability: Conflicts with master, but reviewing the logic now is worthwhile as the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Concept approval citing demand from downstream projects relying on Core (winterrdog)
Unaddressed objection: a second node can overwrite an active socket file without error (b-l-u-e)
Unaddressed objection: bitcoin-cli sends resolved IP in Host header instead of hostname (b-l-u-e)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds long-requested UNIX domain socket support for local RPC connections
Operators can manage RPC access via standard filesystem permissions instead of IP filtering
Eliminates TCP loopback overhead for local RPC clients
